def get_girth(n, adj):

        adj[u].add(v)

        u, v = e1
        x, y = e2

        adj[x].remove(y); adj[y].remove(x)
        adj[u].add(x); adj[x].add(u)
        adj[v].add(y); adj[y].add(v)
        
        new_edges = [e for e in edges if e != e1 and e != e2]
        new_edges.append(tuple(sorted((u, x))))
        new_edges.append(tuple(sorted((v, y))))
